build_comparison.meaning: Sum of resident ELF section sizes reported by the build; not a measurement of peak heap usage or device memory availability.

validation: Runtime maximum-size hash table test covers collisions, duplicate rejection and retry.
Host C API test configures and enumerates 2048 names and attaches the final entries.
Firmware verifier rejects catalogs exceeding the runtime limit.
limitations: Catalog storage remains a fixed-size copied array. Increasing the cap does not remove the limit.
ARM build size does not establish that loading will succeed on the device, nor does it validate concurrency or failure recovery.
Physical hook sites and retired dispatch slots remain limited independently of catalog capacity.
